findings.disposition: Corrected fixture source copy: open read-only, validate the opened descriptor as a regular file with matching identity, size and nanosecond change stamps before reading, read that descriptor only, validate again and close before destination creation. The exact final real-filesystem replacement test gives two passes and one failure against3660ff1, and all three pass after correction. All three controls also passed actual x64 Windows contracts and selected runs; final copier executed real acceptance package/dependency files on x64 and ARM64.

Individually reviewed bounded false positive at the read-only fixture open. The query recognizes the preceding path check/open pair but does not model subsequent descriptor validation. No bytes are read until the opened identity/change stamps match; the same descriptor is read and rechecked. Open does not create, truncate, write or change ACLs. Actual replacement is refused. No rule or source suppression was added.
